title: Put the total into the table footer
goal: Use tfoot to group summary rows from detail rows.
summary: The receipt record already has a header and a table body, and the total row belongs to a separate table area.
tasks: Move the entire row "Total 10" to the new tfoot, retaining scope="row" in the row header.

example.note: tfoot is placed in the table and can be used to store one or more rows of summary data.

hint: Move the entire line tr after the end of tbody and before the end of table.
